name: fork-cleanup
description: Off by default. Deletes stale forks from your own GitHub account when a session starts. Dry-run until you switch it on.

github_account.title: GitHub account
github_account.description: The account whose forks may be cleaned up. Empty means the hook does nothing.

delete_forks.title: Delete for real
delete_forks.description: Off: only log what would be deleted. On: delete forks that meet every condition. Deleting a repository cannot be undone.

min_age_days.title: Minimum fork age in days
min_age_days.description: Only forks created at least this many days ago are considered.

keep.title: Keep list
keep.description: Comma-separated forks to never touch, as owner/name or just name.
